thread:
ella (sales): Heads up — Cygnus Health signed LOI, wants SLA included in contract. They
re asking 99.99% uptime, p95 latency <200ms for text-gen endpoints, and 24/7 premium support with 1hr escalation window. Can product weigh in on feasibility vs cost? :eyes:
anya (product): Thanks. Quick clarifying q's: 1) expected RPS and peak concurrency? 2) single-region or multi-region requirement? 3) is data residency a factor?
ella (sales): RPS ~ 120 req/s steady, peaks 450 for 2-3h/day. Must be US-only for now. They
lso said "business-critical" LLM features.
mike (support): For 24/7 premium support we need documented on-call rotation + playbooks. We can do 1hr ack SLA but need runbooks and an escalation matrix from eng.
suhas (eng-sre): 99.99% rolling monthly means ~4.3 min downtime/month. With our current single-hosted pools, this is tight. Options: (A) Dedicated capacity with multi-AZ failover and hot-standby (higher cost), (B) Hosted route + guaranteed capacity reservations + active failover to another region (still needs Multi-region exposure), (C) Contracted degraded SLO for maintenance windows. We also need clear definition of what counts as "downtime" (5xx vs latency).
anya (product): Good point — define SLOs precisely in contract. Proposal: uptime SLO = 99.95 initial (pilot) with objective to reach 99.99 after 90 days if traffic pattern stable and we provision dedicated pool. Latency SLO: p95 <200ms for gen-light model; p95 <300ms for heavier models. Fallback policy: if error budget burn > threshold, automatically route to best-effort model variant and notify customer.
jess (devex): Implementation notes: Console needs a per-customer SLO dashboard + ability to pin model variants and set routing policy. Also will need SDK flags for "slo_tier": "premium" to show rate-limits and retry semantics. Timeline: ~3 sprints for console + SDK shims.
suhas (eng-sre): To hit 99.99 for that traffic we estimate a sustained reserved pool of 10 A100s (approx). Autoscale must be constrained (warm instances) and we need KV cache priming. Also require synthetic e2e checks from multiple regions and sub-1min alerting on egress errors. Cost uplift estimate: ~3x for infra + 20% ops staffing.
ella (sales): Cygnus is willing to pay premium but expects pricing bracket & clear ramp plan. They want 1hr support SLA in contract and named POCs for escalation.
legal-bot: Heads-up: any SLA > 99.9% triggers additional legal review. Need to include force majeure, maintenance window carve-outs, audit rights, and indemnity boundaries.
mike (support): I'll draft the oncall rota + runbook template. Need product to confirm escalation paths and severity definitions (sev1 = app down, sev2 = degraded latency impacting revenue).
anya (product): Acceptance criteria for launching "Cygnus premium SLO": 1) Dedicated capacity design doc signed off by eng-sre 2) Console + SDK feature for SLO display and routing 3) Runbooks + test incident drill completed 4) Contract language approved by legal 5) Post-deploy synthetic coverage and dashboards live. If any missing, ship as "pilot-tier 99.95" with explicit change-control.
suhas (eng-sre): I'll open infra-IAM ticket for isolated pool, and a runbook PR. Also need to coordinate with eng-runtime for KV cache warmers and quantization profile pins.
ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8743 for dedicated pool provisioning and ENG-PR-452 for runbook review.
jess (devex): Quick UX ask: show "SLO stage" on customer card (pilot vs premium) + link to runbook. Small mock in Figma, will share.
ella (sales): Next step: schedule 30m scoping with Cygnus + attach cost uplift and pilot timeline. I'll ask legal to start contract redline.
anya (product): I'll create an intake doc and add to backlog with label "enterprise-slo-cygnus". Assign PM owner and set spike to validate capacity numbers. Target: pilot in 8 weeks if sign-off done this week. :thumbsup:
ella (sales): Great, I'll ping Cygnus to confirm scoping slot. Thanks all.

[attached snippet]
```
SLO: uptime >= 99.95% (30d rolling) -> target 99.99% after Q1 pilot
Latency: p95 <= 200ms (gen-light), p95 <= 300ms (gen-heavy)
Escalation: 1hr ack for Sev1, 4hr ack for Sev2
Maintenance: 4hr planned maintenance window/month excluded from downtime
```
